name: HERMES_CROSS_SOURCE_SYNTHESIS_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: HERMES_CROSS_SOURCE_SYNTHESIS_20261107 — hermes-cross-source-synthesizer failed 4 runs in
a row with a receipt that said only 'NO_BRIEFS'. Two defects in one script:
(1) collect_signal_bundle filtered content_entity_links on extracted_at, a column the table does
not have (it has created_at). PostgreSQL aborts the whole transaction on that first failed
statement, so the other five sources answered 'current transaction is aborted' and TWO more were
silently turned into []. The bundle the model received was empty (0 signals) on every run until
2026-11-07; live read-only after the fix: 20 entity_spikes, 15 news_themes, 10 discovery_signals,
(2) the prompt never asked for limitations/source_views, which hermes_staging_ingest requires for
hermes_research_intelligence, so every brief the lane ever produced was rejected ('limitations
array is empty or missing') — even the 5 it generated on 2026-11-05.
The gate pins: one failing source costs one source (rollback restores the transaction and the
error is recorded, never a silent []); the entity query names a column that exists; synthesize
reports WHY it returned nothing; the prompt asks for the required fields; a brief without
limitations is still stageable (method limitation, not invented evidence) while a brief with no
sources at all is still rejected; and the NO_BRIEFS receipt carries the cause.
Hermetic: fake connections/cursors with real postgres aborted-transaction semantics, stubbed
generate_cloud, the real validate_payload. No DB, no model, no network.
